entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I need to make a return. I bought these cycling shoes but your website is just so confusing. I couldn't figure out the process.

I can certainly help you with that. I'm sorry to hear the website was unclear. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
I guess preference? They just hurt. I've tried moving the cleats around, but no matter what I do, they give me terrible blisters after every ride. I just want to send them back for a refund.
I understand, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your account to check the return eligibility. Do you have your order number handy?
I think so... hold on. It's VF88602. I just don't get the rules, it seems so complicated. Can't you just help me?
Of course, that's what I'm here for. Let me take a look... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Road Cycling Shoes, delivered 31 days ago. Let me just check our policy.
Alright, I have good news. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. I can process this return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with them. Thank you.

It's no problem at all. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much for making it so easy, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
